,CAST(YDAB.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(DAYOFYEAR, CONVERT(CHAR(10),  LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12),8), 120)) AS DECIMAL(25,4)) YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE
,CAST(CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL
      ELSE EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL * BCC.ConversionRate END AS DECIMAL(25,4)) OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
,0 AS PREVIOUS_MONTHEND_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP
,CAST(CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN YDAB.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(DAYOFYEAR, CONVERT(CHAR(10),  LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12),8), 120))
      ELSE (YDAB.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(DAYOFYEAR, CONVERT(CHAR(10), LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12),8), 120))) * BCC.ConversionRate END AS DECIMAL(25,4))  YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP
,DATEPART(DAYOFYEAR, CONVERT(CHAR(10),  LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12),8), 120)) AS DAY_OF_YEAR 
,CAST(CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN 1 ELSE BCC.ConversionRate END AS DECIMAL(15,10)) CONVERSION_RATE


------OTHER------
,'NA' AS MONTH_YEAR
,'NA' AS MTD_BANK_ID
,'NA' AS MTD_SOL_ID
,'NA' AS MTD_SCHM_CODE
,'NA' AS MTD_SCHM_TYPE
,'NA' AS MTD_ACID
,'NA' AS MTD_FORACID
,'NA' AS MTD_ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
,'1900-01-01' AS TRANDATE
,0 AS AVE_CURR_BALANCE
,0 AS AVE_CLR_BALANCE
,0 AS NO_DAYS
,'NA' AS USERID
,'1900-01-01' AS MTD_LCHG_TIME
,'NA' AS QUARTER_YEAR
,'NA' AS MTD_LAST6_ACC_NUM
,'NA' AS MTD_BNK_CODE
,'NA' AS MTD_SOURCE_CODE
,'NA' AS MTD_FILE_NAME
,'1900-01-01' AS MTD_INSERT_DTTM
,@DateProcessed AS As_Of_Date
,CASE 
	WHEN COALESCE(
					CASE
						WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' 
							AND GAM.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= @DateProcessed
							AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
							THEN 'C'
						WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N'
							AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA')
							THEN CASA.ACCT_STATUS
						WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' 
							AND GAM.ACCT_CLS_DATE > @DateProcessed
							AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA')
							THEN CASA.ACCT_STATUS
						WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' 
							AND GAM.ACCT_CLS_DATE > @DateProcessed
							AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('TDA')
							THEN TD.ACCT_STATUS
						WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N'
							AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('TDA')
							THEN TD.ACCT_STATUS
					END
					, '') = '' 
					AND ACCT_OPN_DATE = @DateProcessed THEN 'A'
	ELSE 
		CASE
			WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' 
				AND GAM.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= @DateProcessed
				AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
				THEN 'C'
			WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N'
				AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA')
				THEN CASA.ACCT_STATUS
			WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' 
				AND GAM.ACCT_CLS_DATE > @DateProcessed
				AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA')
				THEN CASA.ACCT_STATUS
			WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' 
				AND GAM.ACCT_CLS_DATE > @DateProcessed
				AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('TDA')
				THEN TD.ACCT_STATUS
			WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N'
				AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('TDA')
				THEN TD.ACCT_STATUS
		END
END AS DEP_Account_Status 


FROM (SELECT * FROM D360.STG_EDS_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL WHERE H = 'D' AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) = @DateProcessed ) GAM 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM D360.STG_EDS_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL WHERE H = 'D' AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) = @DateProcessed ) EAB 
ON GAM.ACID = EAB.ACID AND GAM.BANK_ID = EAB.BANK_ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM D360.STG_EDS_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCESFULL WHERE H = 'D' AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) = @DateProcessed) YDAB 
ON GAM.ACID = YDAB.ACID AND GAM.BANK_ID = YDAB.BANK_ID
LEFT JOIN  (SELECT * FROM bnkm.currencyconversion where ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' AND CurrencyConversionTimestamp = @DateProcessed ) BCC ON 
GAM.BANK_ID = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = BCC.ConvertFromCurrencyId

LEFT JOIN EDS.DEP_CASAMASTER CASA
	ON GAM.ACID = CASA.ACID
	AND GAM.BANK_ID = CASA.BANK_ID
	AND @DateProcessed BETWEEN CASA.SCD_START_DATE AND CASA.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEP_TDMASTER TD
	ON GAM.ACID = TD.ACID
	AND GAM.BANK_ID = TD.BANK_ID
	AND @DateProcessed BETWEEN TD.SCD_START_DATE AND TD.SCD_END_DATE
